title: Onboarding Experience Partner
description:
**Company Description** **Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait.**


We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.


For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).


‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency


Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**  

Onboarding Experience Partner \- End\-to\-End Onboarding \& Day 1 Experience

  

We are looking for a proactive, empathetic, and detail\-oriented professional to serve as the single point of contact for candidates throughout their onboarding journey, from Interview Selection to successful Day 1 Onboarding and Reporting.


The role is responsible for managing the complete candidate onboarding lifecycle, including candidate engagement, offer acceptance support, onboarding coordination, Background Verification , Pre\-Medical management, Joining \& Relocation, Day 1 induction readiness, compliance governance, and employee experience management to ensure a seamless, compliant, and engaging onboarding experience.


Key Responsibilities


End\-to\-End Onboarding Ownership

* Own the complete onboarding lifecycle from interview selection to Day 1 reporting.
* Serve as the dedicated SPOC for candidates throughout their onboarding journey.
* Proactively engage with candidates to drive readiness, confidence, and joining commitment.
* Ensure timely completion of all onboarding milestones and compliance requirements.


Candidate Experience \& Engagement

* Build meaningful relationships with candidates and provide personalized support.
* Drive a best\-in\-class onboarding experience that strengthens employer brand perception.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact candidate joining.
* Support offer acceptance, relocation, joining formalities, and pre\-joining queries.


Operational Excellence \& Governance

* Manage Background Verification , Pre\-Medical, documentation, and onboarding compliance processes.
* Track onboarding readiness and maintain governance dashboards and trackers.
* Monitor onboarding SLAs and ensure timely closure of activities.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to resolve bottlenecks and escalations.


Day 1 Experience Management

* Ensure complete Day 1 readiness, including system access, assets, workspace, and induction arrangements.
* Facilitate virtual and in\-person Day 1 induction programs.
* Troubleshoot onboarding issues and drive timely resolution.
* Deliver a smooth and memorable first\-day employee experience.


Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Hiring Managers, IT, Facilities, Security, Payroll, Finance, Admin, Vendors, and Business Leaders.
* Provide onboarding insights, updates, and risk assessments to stakeholders.
* Influence decisions and drive accountability across cross\-functional teams.


Continuous Improvement

* Identify process gaps and recommend automation and experience enhancement opportunities.
* Analyze onboarding metrics and trends to improve candidate conversion and onboarding effectiveness.
* Contribute to transformation and employee experience initiatives.


What We're Looking For


Essential Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and risk\-management capabilities.
* High attention to detail and process orientation.
* Passion for employee and candidate experience.


Preferred Experience

* Experience in End\-to\-End Onboarding, HR Operations, Candidate Experience, Recruitment Coordination, Employee Experience, or Shared Services Operations.
* Familiarity with BGV, Pre\-Medical, Documentation, Joining Formalities, Day 1 Induction, and HR compliance processes.
* Hands\-on experience with HR systems and onboarding platforms.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders and external vendors.


Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3\-6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Experience, Onboarding, Talent Operations, or Candidate Lifecycle Management.


Success in This Role Means

* High Interview\-to\-Join Conversion.
* Exceptional Candidate Experience Scores.
* Smooth Day 1 Readiness and Induction Delivery.
* Strong Stakeholder Satisfaction.
* Zero Compliance Gaps.
* Continuous Process Improvement and Automation Adoption.


Why Join Us?


This role provides a unique opportunity to directly influence how employees experience our organization from the very beginning. You will work with senior stakeholders, drive meaningful employee experience outcomes, lead critical onboarding initiatives, and play a pivotal role in shaping the future workforce experience.

**If you are passionate about people, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to create exceptional employee experiences at scale, we'd love to hear from you.**

 **Qualifications**  

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administrationor a related field.


3\-6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Experience, Onboarding, Talent Operations, or Candidate Lifecycle Management.

 **Additional Information** **About the Department \- Human Resources**


The Human Resources department at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories is the organizational heartbeat, dedicated to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment for their 24,000\+ employees. As a well\-executed Human Resources (HR) team, we foster a positive and productive workplace. Effective HR practices are involved in recruiting and retaining top talent, providing comprehensive employee development programs, and ensuring fair and transparent policies. The robust HR department at Dr. Reddys is cultivating a culture of open communication, employee engagement, and diversity and inclusion. Moreover, it plays a crucial role in conflict resolution, fostering a healthy work environment and aligns organizational goals with the well\-being and professional growth of its employees, contributing significantly to overall company success.

**Benefits Offered**


At Dr. Reddy's, we actively help to catalyze your career growth and professional development through personalized learning programs. The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy's are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.

**Our Work Culture**


Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy's why they come to work every day and they'll say, because Good Health Can't Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we're always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.


For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/\#!/.

title: Senior Learning Measurement Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**  

Job Purpose/Overview
  
  

The Senior Learning Measurement Analyst plays a pivotal role within Mars University’s Learning Measurement team, supporting the team by managing data, analysis, and reporting to evaluate the impact of learning programs. This role combines data transformation with visualization, applying analytical techniques where appropriate to create visibility to learning effectiveness and business value. The analyst collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, optimize reporting processes, and deliver insights that drive continuous improvement.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Data Operations Automation: Own the design and delivery of scalable reports and dashboards that support core learning operations (e.g., nominations, demand planning, evaluations). Continuously improve the data ecosystem by automating, standardizing, and optimizing reporting processes to enhance data usability and reduce manual effort.
* Program Portfolio Measurement: Support measurement efforts for priority learning programs, including KPI development, pre\- and post\-training assessment analysis, and summarizing key takeaways. Lead data support for new initiatives, such as pilots and new program launches.
* Insights Added Business Value: Take a consultative approach to data requests, helping stakeholders define their needs and shaping solutions that add strategic value. Investigate and resolve data discrepancies or broken reports independently, setting up new methods when standard procedures do not apply.
* Mentorship Partnership: Serve as a technical mentor and thought partner for colleagues within the Learning Measurement team. Act as a key liaison with partners across MGS Learning, PO, and Functional teams to deliver accurate, relevant data and represent the Learning Measurement Strategy.
* Governance Documentation: Promote best practices in data protection, documentation, and quality control. Maintain clear documentation on how reports are built, where numbers come from, and what definitions are used.


Context and Scope
  
  

This role operates within the global Learning Measurement team, managing data projects from intake through to delivery with a high degree of autonomy. The analyst will partner closely with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders across different segments of the business, translating technical findings into business\-relevant recommendations. The position requires a structured, problem\-solving mindset to uncover new and less obvious solutions that drive stakeholder impact.
  
  

Job Specifications/Qualifications
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field with 3 years of experience in data and reporting
  
  

Knowledge / Experience
  
  

* Strong practical experience preparing, cleaning, and combining data from multiple sources (such as SQL, Excel, or automated data flows)
* Ability to run basic and intermediate statistical summaries (such as averages, standard deviations, distributions, and pre/post score comparisons) to find key insights and explain trends
* Proven ability to build and maintain clean, easy\-to\-use dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools
* Ability to identify unusual data issues, find where things went wrong, and fix them independently
* Experience supporting junior colleagues, helping them troubleshoot data issues and checking work for quality and accuracy
* Experience finding manual or repetitive reporting steps and making them simpler or automated
* Clear verbal and written English skills to explain data findings simply to colleagues and stakeholders
* Experienced in digital fluency and demonstrated curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies including AI to drive innovation and continuous improvement
* Experience in working with learning or HR data (e.g., training completions, program effectiveness, people data) is preferred.

title: Manager - Executive Recruitments
description:
**About Providence**
--------------------


Providence, one of the US’s largest not\-for\-profit healthcare systems, is committed to high quality, compassionate healthcare for all. Driven by the belief that health is a human right and the vision, ‘Health for a better world’, Providence and its 121,000 caregivers strive to provide everyone access to affordable quality care and services.


Providence has a network of 51 hospitals, 1,000\+ care clinics, senior services, supportive housing, and other health and educational services in the US.


Providence India is bringing to fruition the transformational shift of the healthcare ecosystem to Health 2\.0\. The India center will have focused efforts around healthcare technology and innovation, and play a vital role in driving digital transformation of health systems for improved patient outcomes and experiences, caregiver efficiency, and running the business of Providence at scale.

  

**Why Us?**
-----------

* Best In\-class Benefits
* Inclusive Leadership
* Reimagining Healthcare
* Competitive Pay
* Supportive Reporting Relation
**The Opportunity**


We are looking for an exemplary Manager / Senior Manager \- Executive Recruitment (Technology) to drive leadership hiring across key technology functions. This role will focus on identifying, engaging, and hiring senior technology talent at the Director, Senior Director, and critical niche leadership levels.

  

The ideal candidate will bring strong executive recruiting expertise, deep understanding of technology talent markets, and the ability to partner with business leaders to deliver high\-quality leadership hiring outcomes. The role requires a blend of executive search, talent mapping, stakeholder management, and market intelligence capabilities.

  

**Leadership Hiring**


* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for technology leadership and critical niche positions.
* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand talent requirements and develop hiring strategies.
* Build and maintain strong pipelines of leadership talent across technology domains.
* Drive passive candidate engagement through direct sourcing, networking, and market research.
* Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
  

**Talent Mapping \& Market Intelligence**


* Conduct talent research and competitive intelligence to identify leadership talent across the market.
* Develop organizational and competitor mappings to support strategic hiring initiatives.
* Provide insights on talent availability, market trends, and competitive landscapes.
* Support workforce planning through external talent intelligence and succession insights.
  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Collaborate with Technology Leaders, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership.
* Act as a trusted recruiting partner to hiring teams throughout the search process.
* Facilitate candidate assessments, interview debriefs, and selection decisions.
* Influence hiring outcomes through consultative and data\-driven recommendations.
  

**Sourcing Excellence**


* Leverage executive search methodologies and external networks to identify top talent.
* Create innovative sourcing strategies for hard\-to\-find technology leaders.
* Build long\-term relationships with passive candidates and industry networks.
* Maintain talent communities for recurring and future hiring needs.
  

**Process \& Governance**


* Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and processes.
* Monitor recruitment metrics including time\-to\-fill, pipeline quality, and hiring effectiveness.
* + Partner with recruitment operations and stakeholders to drive continuous process improvements.
	+ Support diversity\-focused hiring initiatives and inclusive recruiting practices.**Education**


	+ Bachelor's degree required.
	+ Postgraduate qualification/MBA preferred.**Experience**


	+ 12\-15 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Executive Search, or Leadership Hiring.
	+ Strong track record in hiring technology leaders across enterprise or consulting organizations.
	+ Experience recruiting Director, Senior Director, and niche technical leadership talent.
	+ Exposure to global hiring and stakeholder management preferred.
Providence’s vision to create ‘Health for a Better World’ aids us to provide a fair and equitable workplace for all in our employment, whether temporary, part\-time or full time, and to promote individuality and diversity of thought and background, and acknowledge its role in the organization’s success. This makes us committed towards equal employment opportunities, regardless of race, religion or belief, color, ancestry, disability, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, pregnancy, or related needs, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, or any other category protected by applicable law. In furtherance to our mission in building a more inclusive and equitable environment, we shall, from time to time, undertake programs to assist, uplift and empower underrepresented groups including but not limited to Women, PWD (Persons with Disabilities), LGTBQ\+ (Lesbian, Gay, Transgender, Bisexual or Queer), Veterans and others. We strive to address all forms of discrimination or harassment and provide a safe and confidential process to report any misconduct.


Contact our Integrity hotline also, read our Code of Conduct.

title: CTK Svc Associate
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  

  

About Amazon Centralized Timekeeping  

  

The vision of the Centralized Timekeeping team is to utilize top talent to streamline time and attendance data entry, reduce payroll defects and provide consistently high service levels. Today, CTK supports and manages time and attendance matters for thousands of Amazon Associates. Requests for edits are submitted via trouble ticketing from operators and HR across the network. The Centralized team manages the ticket queue by executing on the requests on a FIFO basis but will prioritize any payroll impacting ticket if there is a risk of a payroll defect. The efforts of this team support the business by ensuring associate’s time and attendance matters are handled with speed, precision and with customer obsession always in mind.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or Advanced Degree
* Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis
* Experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment, or experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience owning end\-to\-end programs to drive results

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with Windows, Word, Excel, MyTime (Kronos) and PowerPoint
* Experience in administrative tasks such as data entry, managing data driven report processes or processes
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience with MS Office Suite, CRMs (Salesforce) and other systems
* 6\+ months of human resources experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
